# #4999: Patch: a Glitch-voided Infinite Assault fight is dealt again, as a dungeon fight is
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Dungeon runs and the daily 20-level Infinite Assault both settle each fight by folding its record. When a Glitch voids a fight, the dungeon run treats it as if it never happened and deals the same fight again with nothing lost. The Assault instead records it as a lost fight, which costs the player the level and the attempt's standing. After this change both modes do the dungeon thing: a voided fight is dealt again from the same setup, and no loss is recorded for a game that never happened.

## Why

- R679: a fight a Glitch voids never happened; R4852000 applied that to dungeon runs (spec 15: it reports nothing, and the run deals it again fresh from the same seed), shipped by #4928. The Assault never got its reading: crates/run/src/assault/attempt.rs says a void still reads as a lost fight there, as it did before R4852000, and that the Assault's own reading is #4576's to make.
- The shared fold behind both reports already returns the reason the game ended (crates/run/src/fight.rs: a void read as any other end); run_fight_report refuses it while assault_fight_report keeps it as a loss. One branch apart.
- Spec 16 (Infinite Assault) is silent on voided fights, and IA6/IA15's rule that a draw at the turn cap is a loss covers draws, not voids — so this rules an open point rather than undoing a decided one.

## Proposal

- Mirror the dungeon branch in assault_fight_report: refuse a voided fight with the same sentence the dungeon uses, and have the caller redeal the same level from the same setup (the setup is deterministic from day seed, level and attempt), leaving the attempt in its Fight phase with HP and record untouched.
- Add the ruling note in the asking issue's block with its named test and its spec/pending paragraph for section 16, since the spec is silent here.
- Tests: a voided Assault fight returns the refusal; the redealt setup plays to an end; a real loss and a turn-cap draw still report as losses.

## Where it lands

- crates/run/src/assault/attempt.rs (assault_fight_report) and crates/run/src/fight.rs (the shared fold and the void constant)
- crates/run/src/assault/fight_tests.rs (void tests beside the existing report tests)
- One new ruling note, its proving tests, and its spec/pending paragraph for section 16

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A Glitch-voided Assault fight returns the void refusal, not a FightOver loss
- [ ] Redealing the same Assault setup after a void plays to an end
- [ ] A real loss and a turn-cap draw still report as losses
- [ ] cargo test -p jackioh-run and cargo jackioh spec check are green

## Size and risks

Small: one branch, a few tests, one ruling. Risk: callers that treat every FightOver as final must handle the refusal by redealing; the dungeon caller already does, so mirror it. Risk: records folded under the old loss reading; settled records stand and only new void reports take the redeal path, stated in the ruling note.
